program_plain: World: 400 self-propelled point particles in a periodic 2D box (square of side 20), density 1 per unit area. Rules, discrete time steps: (1) each particle sets its heading to the average heading of all particles within distance 1 (itself included), plus a uniformly random angle in [-eta*pi, eta*pi], with noise eta = 0.318 (a random angle between -1 and 1 radian); (2) it moves 0.5 along its new heading. Start from random positions and random headings along the four lattice directions. Run 1,000 steps.
